RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  November 22, 2010/Agrahayana 1, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Coal; Corporate Affairs; Development of North Eastern Region;
Environment and Forests; Food Processing Industries; Information and
Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and
Renewable Energy; Power; Statistics and Programme
Implementation; Tribal Affairs; Women
and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 20
50
Supplementary nutrition under
ICDS Scheme
*161. SHRIMATI KANIMOZHI: Will
the Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the amount of money
allocated to each child through the
Integrated Child Development Services
(ICDS) Scheme as fixed by the Supreme
Court is at least 
` 2 per child per day for
supplementary nutrition out of which the
Central Government shall contribute ` 1
per child per day;
(b) whether as reported in the media,
the food inflation has touched an 11 year
high of 19.95 per cent in December, 2009;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) whether Government is
contemplating an increase in budget
allocated for each child through ICDS
Scheme so that they get sufficient
supplementary nutrition?
Doordarshan tower at Chirgaon in
Himachal Pradesh
†*162. SHRIMATI BIMLA
KASHYAP SOOD: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether most of the villages under
tehsil Chirgaon, district Shimla, Himachal
Pradesh are not covered by Doordarshan;
(b) whether tower installed in Chirgaon
is of very low power transmission capacity
and inspite of receiving representations
from about 20 Grampradhans and different
institutions, Ministry has ignored their
requests for increasing its capacity and
changing its location;
(c) whether in response to questions
asked by former MP of Shimla, Ministry
has not taken any action due to incorrect
information provided by concerned officers
without conducting any on-the-spot
inspection; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

51
(d) if so, remedial action to be taken by
Government after conducting an inspection
in the matter?
Poaching activity near Sariska
Wildlife Sanctuary
*163. SHRI Y .S. CHOWDARY: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether any cases of poaching
activity in the Aravalli ranges, mainly near
Sariska Wildlife Sanctuary have been
brought to Government's notice;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has taken any
action on these complaints;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the details of the loss/damage caused
to wildlife due to these activities?
Compensation to NTPC
*164. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN: Will
the Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether the National Thermal Power
Corporation (NTPC) is to get 
` 600 crore
compensation;
(b) if so, the details worked out so far,
State-wise; and
(c) the parameters adopted therefor
during the Eleventh Five Year Plan, State-
wise?
Tigers missing from Ranthambhore
Tiger Reserve
†*165. SHRI OM PRAKASH
MATHUR: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that two tigers
are reported missing from Rajasthan's
Ranthambhore Tiger Reserve during the last
two months;
(b) the number of persons attacked by
these tigers;
(c) whether the missing tigers have not
been traced so far, by the Sanctuary
administration; and
(d) whether these tigers are still being
traced on the basis of their pugmarks
despite modern techniques being in place?
Supply of coal to power plants
*166. SHRI BHARATSINH
PRABHATSINH PARMAR: W ill the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to short
supply of coal to various thermal power
plants in the western States, particularly
with regard to Gujarat, the power generation
has sharply gone down in recent years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of coal being supplied to
various power plants in the country vis-a-
vis their demands during the last three years
and as on date; and
(d) the details of coal imported by the
Coal India Limited during the years
2009-10 and 2010-11?
Expenditure on broadcasting of
Commonwealth Games
*167. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: W ill the
Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) the money spent for broadcasting of
Commonwealth Games;
(b) whether any assets have been
created by utilizing this money; and
(c) the money spent for outsourcing?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

52
Deaths of wild animals
†*168. SHRI KAPTAN SINGH
SOLANKI: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that instances of
death of wild animals are continuously
increasing throughout the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government is formulating
any policy to make national parks more
secure and to provide more facilities thereon;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Demand-supply gap of
 power
†*169. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD: Will the Minister of POWER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that with the
increasing power generation capacity, the
gap between demand and supply of power
is getting reduced;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the extent
to which this gap has been reduced in
September, 2010 as against  September,
2009; and
(c) the contribution of Government and
private sector companies in increasing
power generation capacity?
Development programmes for
minorities
*170. SHRI RAASHID ALVI: Will the
Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the development
programmes for minorities;
(b) the funds allocated by the Central
Government for implementation of these
programmes during the last three years; and
(c) the un-utilized funds, during the
above period, State-wise?
Regulatory authority to check illegal
mining
*171. SARDAR SUKHDEV SINGH
DHINDSA: Will the Minister of MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
to set up an independent regulatory
authority with powers to investigate and
prosecute those indulging in illegal mining;
and
(b) if so, the progress made so far in
this regard?
Declaration of bamboo as a grass
*172. SHRI ANIL MADHA V DAVE:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
declare bamboo as a grass;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
WFP's report on malnutrition
*173. SHRI BIRENDRA PRASAD
BAISHYA: Will the Minister of WOMEN
AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that according to
World Food Programme (WFP), more than
27 per cent of the world's undernourished
live in India and malnutrition accounts for
50 per cent child deaths and 43 per cent
children are under weight;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

53
(b) the efforts Government has initiated
to tackle the menace of child deaths;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
benefits of most of the schemes/projects
do not reach the targeted children;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether the Ministry monitors its
various welfare schemes/projects meant for
the women and children; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Punishment to agitating coal mine
workers
†*174. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY: Will the Minister of COAL be
pleased to state:
(a) whether many employees working
in coal mines were punished due to
participation in agitations initiated by
employees unions recently; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Derecognition of law colleges
*175. SHRI Y . P . TRIVEDI: Will the
Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Bar Council of India
has decided to derecognize more than 30
law colleges, while 20 other have been
served with notice to improve
infrastructure; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor?
Protection of biodiversity of the
Eastern Ghats
*176. SHRIMATI T. RA TNA BAI:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has identified
the eco-sensitive  areas in the Eastern Ghats;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what initiatives are being taken to
protect biodiversity of the Eastern Ghats;
(d) whether the Ministry plans to set
up an Expert Panel for the the Eastern Ghats
similiar to the Western Ghats Ecology
Expert Panel; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Pending cases in Uttar Pradesh
*177. DR. AKHILESH DAS GUPTA:
Will the Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that more than
five million cases are pending in the
subordinate courts of Uttar Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons for such huge pendency;
(c) whether poor infrastructure is one
of the main reason therefor;
(d) if so, what efforts Government has
made so far to improve the infrastructure
of subordinate courts in the State; and
(e) what other measures Government
proposes to initiate to speed up disposal
of cases in subordinate courts of the State?
High Court's in North Eastern
 States
*178. DR. E.M. SUDARSANA
NATCHIAPPAN: Will the Minister of
LAW AND JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
the recommendations of the Department-
related Parliamentary Standing Committee
on Personnel, Public Grievances, Law and
Justice to establish High Courts in every
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

54
State in North Eastern Region so that tribal
law can be made as Judges made law for
enacting comprehensive civil code for tribal
States; and
(b) if not, whether it  would be another
reason for alienating the people of these
States as denial to have all the three pillars
of the 'State'?
Accidents in coal mines
*179. SHRI NARENDRA KUMAR
KASHYAP: Will the Minister of COAL
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the accidents that took
place in various coal mines in the country
during the last three years, year-wise and
company-wise;
(b) the details of the incidents wherein
the Court of Inquiry has been constituted
during the said period; and
(c) the number of officers found guilty
and the action taken against them?
Rural electrification
†*180. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY: Will
the Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of villages in the
country and out of these how many villages
have been electrified , State-wise;
(b) the reasons for non-electrification
of those villages;
(c) by when those villages would be
electrified; and
(d) the details of Government's plan for
meeting the increasing demand of electricity
and electrification of remote villages?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 16th November, 2010 Secretary-General.
Kartika 25, 1932 (Saka)
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
